messages:
maya: Hey team — first day and trying to hit the internal docs site, but it times out from home. I can SSH to the bastion but requests to 10.45.x.x services fail. Anyone seen this with UK home ISPs?
ryan: welcome! :wave: quick q — are you on split-tunnel or full-tunnel VPN?
maya: using company WireGuard profile (macOS), it shows split-tunnel in the client. internal DNS resolves to 10.45.2.12 but curl hangs.
samir: sometimes the ISP does carrier NAT and breaks hairpinning for our internal services. can you paste the output of `scutil --dns` and `route -n get default`?
maya: here —
```
System DNS configuration
nameserver[0] : 10.1.1.8
resolver #1
  search domain[0] : corp.redwood
  nameserver[0] : 10.45.1.10
```
and default route shows my local gateway 192.168.1.1
ryan: ok that looks like split-tunnel handing DNS to the tunnel but not routing traffic through it. try `curl --interface wg0 http://10.45.2.12/health` — that forces the WireGuard interface.
maya: `curl: (7) Failed to connect to 10.45.2.12 port 80: No route to host`
ryan: can you SSH jump to the bastion and curl the service from there? like `ssh -J maya@bastion-eu-1 redwood-internal@internal-host 'curl -sS http://10.45.2.12/health'`
maya: infra-bot just posted that my bastion account created: `infra-bot: user/maya provisioned on bastion-eu-1`
maya: running the ssh + curl now... got `{"status":"ok"}` from the bastion curl
ryan: means service is healthy but your client isn't sending traffic through the tunnel. likely the WireGuard allowed-ips only includes 10.45/16 and corp DNS, but macOS route priority is sending to local NIC. two quick workarounds:
1) add a specific route for 10.45.0.0/16 via the wg0 gateway: `sudo route -n add -net 10.45.0.0/16 -interface wg0`
2) use an SSH SOCKS proxy through the bastion: `ssh -D 1080 maya@bastion-eu-1` then set your browser/system proxy to SOCKS5 localhost:1080

samir: also check Profiles > WireGuard > Enable 'Send All Traffic' if allowed (company policy depends) — that'll force full-tunnel.
maya: tried option 1, route added and `curl http://10.45.2.12/health` now returns OK. thanks!
ryan: nice. follow-up: I'll open a ticket for IT to check the client profile for macOS so it installs the route automatically. @it-support can you take a look at the WG profile templating for new hires in EU?
it-support: on it. tagging infra to update the onboarding docs — we should add the explicit route step for some home networks. :white_check_mark:
maya: one last thing — is there a recommended SSH config for jumping through bastion for internal git? current clone hangs unless I do ssh -J manually.
ryan: drop this in your ~/.ssh/config:
```
Host *.corp.redwood
  User redwood-internal
  ProxyJump maya@bastion-eu-1
```
then `git clone git@repo.corp.redwood:team/tooling.git` should just work.
maya: done, confirmed cloning works. thanks everyone! :tada:
ryan: welcome again — ping if anything else pops up. we should add a short FAQ to the new-hires channel about home ISP edge cases.
